Job Description

Are you motivated by creating measurable improvements through data, technology, and customer insights? Do you want to influence how millions of customers experience JYSK across multiple markets?

At JYSK, we are expanding our team to strengthen our digital foundation and unlock new opportunities within marketing technology. We are looking for an Email Marketing Automation & Conversion Specialist who can help optimise customer journeys, improve conversion rates, and ensure our email communication performs at its best.

Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will join an informal, social, and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key to success. In this specialist role, you will work at the intersection of technology, data, and customer experience, helping JYSK take the next step in optimisation, personalisation, and marketing automation across digital channels.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

This is an opportunity to join a large international retailer where your work will have a visible impact across multiple markets. You will play a key role in strengthening JYSK's capabilities within conversion rate optimisation, email marketing automation, customer journey optimisation, and email deliverability.

You will become part of a team that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We believe in giving our employees responsibility and freedom with accountability, allowing you to influence both your own development and how we work. At JYSK, your dedication creates opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to business results across our international organisation.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in shaping and improving customer journeys across multiple international markets

• The opportunity to establish new ways of working within landing page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation

• Responsibility and freedom to drive projects and improvements within your area of expertise

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues across Marketing, Ecommerce, Customer Data and IT

• Professional development opportunities within CRO, marketing automation, customer journey optimisation and email deliverability

• Access to modern MarTech platforms and technologies used by a leading international retailer

• An informal and supportive working environment characterised by trust, teamwork and straightforward communication

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Email Marketing Automation & Conversion Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, testing, implementing, and scaling optimisation initiatives that improve customer experiences and business performance. Combining analytical insight, technical understanding, and stakeholder management, you will transform data into tangible results.

One of your first achievements in the role will be helping establish stronger ways of working around landing pages and conversion optimisation while driving initiatives that strengthen inbox presence, sender reputation, and email performance across JYSK markets.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Analysing conversion performance across campaigns, customer journeys and markets to identify optimisation opportunities

• Driving conversion rate optimisation initiatives across landing pages, website modules and digital customer journeys

• Improving email deliverability, inbox placement, sender reputation and list health across markets

• Developing and validating test hypotheses related to segmentation, content, timing, customer journeys and personalisation

• Collaborating with Ecommerce, DXP, Digital Media, Customer Data and IT teams to improve customer experiences

• Monitoring, analysing and reporting on conversion, deliverability and engagement KPIs to support data-driven decisions

• Supporting technical initiatives within Email Marketing including authentication, tracking and optimisation projects

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You are motivated by turning insights into improvements and enjoy taking ownership of optimisation initiatives from idea to implementation. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and thrive in a role where data, technology, and customer experience come together.

You work in a structured and detail-oriented way and are comfortable navigating both technical discussions and business priorities. While you are self-driven and capable of working independently, you also value collaboration and actively share knowledge and best practices with colleagues. This role will suit someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, improving performance through testing and optimisation, and creating measurable impact. Based on the preferred behavioural profile, you are likely to balance independence with collaboration, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and take a methodical approach to problem-solving.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has experience within CRO, marketing automation, email marketing, digital marketing or a related field

• Has a relevant educational background such as a Professional Bachelor's degree in E-commerce and Digital Marketing, Cand.IT or a similar discipline

• Takes ownership and drives optimisation initiatives independently from analysis through implementation

• Combines analytical thinking with a structured and detail-oriented approach

• Has experience working with conversion optimisation, customer journeys, testing methodologies and data analysis

• Understands email deliverability, audience segmentation, personalisation and marketing automation principles

• Builds strong relationships and collaborates effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders

Experience with Bloomreach, Drupal, Dynamic Yield, Google Postmaster Tools, HTML, CSS and Jinja will be considered an advantage.

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader, Email Marketing, Martin Ry Mathiasen at +45 31 23 90 10.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

jobs.occupation: DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 14th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Empowerment & Leadership: Mentor and develop a team of 5 Product Support Specialists (including one fully remote). After our in depth onboarding, you will step back from daily ticket execution to empower the team, delegating ownership of strategic projects and functional areas so they can grow as independent, proactive professionals.

• Proactive Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with Sales & CS, moving beyond reactive troubleshooting to actively equip CSMs with the technical insights and operational backing needed to unlock customer value and drive account expansion.

• Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise issues across our hardware, telematics, and app ecosystem, ensuring prompt root-cause resolution.

• Enterprise Partner Governance: Lead the onboarding and training of 15 -20 international CIC and market support leads, ensuring local operations can support our product at scale.

• Zendesk Architecture: Own and optimize our Zendesk setup - designing efficient ticket routing, automation, SLAs, and performance metrics.

• Training Frameworks: Collaborate with Product & Brand Marketing to create scalable training templates and academy materials for internal teams, external CICs, and end-users.

What You Bring

• Support Leadership: A proven track record of leading B2B technical support in a high-growth SaaS, IoT, or tech environment, with a strong focus on fostering team autonomy and delegating project leadership.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable with software integrations, app/hardware diagnostics, and APIs, paired with a strong understanding of how proactive support drives product adoption, customer value, and long-term retention.

• Global Stakeholder Management: Experience working with multinational enterprise accounts and multi-market partner teams.

• Zendesk Expertise: Hands-on experience configuring and administering Zendesk for automated, scalable workflows.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to translate complex technical realities into clear guidance for both technical and commercial stakeholders.

Why Connected Cars?

• The opportunity to shape a vital support function during a critical phase of international growth.

• A collaborative culture valuing technical rigor and commercial ambition.

• Competitive salary, attractive pension, Friday bars, monthly social events, affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited office snacks.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. A cover letter is optional, but feel free to add one if there is extra context you’d like to share.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. You are comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and can translate complex issues into clear and actionable tasks.

We imagine that you have a relevant educational background and some experience working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, take ownership and build specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

We imagine that you have:

• A relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it. or a similar degree combining IT, business, finance or accounting.

• Some experience from IT consulting, business analysis, application management, system support or a similar field. Recent graduates with a strong interest in IT and financial services are also welcome.

• Good analytical skills and an interest in investigating issues, understanding complex problems and identifying solutions.

• Technical understanding and an interest in IT systems, combined with an interest in banking, financial services or digitalisation. Experience with corporate credit, credit processes or financial statement analysis is an advantage, but not a requirement. Programming skills are not required.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, spoken and written, is mandatory.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparing.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

**

Le/La Responsable International(e) de la Formation Clinique et de la Stratégie CVUS est chargé(e) de définir et de déployer la stratégie internationale de formation clinique et d’alignement, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes.

Ce rôle garantit une forte différenciation clinique du portefeuille produits grâce à des programmes de formation efficaces, des partenariats avec des tiers et un alignement étroit avec le Marketing sur le positionnement concurrentiel, afin de maximiser l’efficacité commerciale et le taux de concrétisation des ventes.

****Job Description

******Key Responsibilities

****Clinical Education & International Clinical Management

**

• Define and lead the international clinical education strategy across regions, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with business priorities.

• Develop, deploy, and continuously optimize clinical education programs addressing customer needs, care pathways, and evolving clinical practices.

**

Job title: Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in building a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research and contribute to shape how it turns emerging biology into molecular interventions. You will co-create new therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, design the molecules that test them and establish their pharmacological potential. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, molecular pharmacology, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, typically complemented by at least eight years of relevant post-PhD research experience, or equivalent scientific contributions and leadership. Relevant experience may come from academia, biotechnology or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Deep expertise in molecular design and a strong understanding of how molecular properties influence pharmacological activity.

• A record of turning original ideas into experimental tools, therapeutic candidates or discovery projects, evidenced through publications, patents, project progression or other relevant contributions.

• Experience connecting chemistry with biological assays and in vivo findings to guide molecular optimisation.

• The ability to evaluate therapeutic modalities and select approaches suited to the target, mechanism and intended site of action.

• Experience leading scientific work and influencing decisions across multidisciplinary collaborations.

• Creativity, sound scientific judgement and a willingness to pursue unfamiliar approaches while testing assumptions rigorously.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Peptide engineering, peptide–drug conjugates or targeted delivery.

• Multi-receptor pharmacology or approaches combining complementary mechanisms.

• Neuropharmacology, cardiometabolic disease or healthspan research.

• Receptor pharmacology and mechanistic assay development.

• Collaborations connecting molecular design, synthesis and biological evaluation.

You are not expected to bring expertise across every modality or therapeutic area.

**What You Will Do

**You will provide scientific leadership at the interface of molecular design, biology and experimental pharmacology.

• Originate therapeutic concepts that connect biological mechanisms with opportunities for molecular intervention, and design molecular tools and drug candidates to establish pharmacological proof of concept.

• Develop strategies involving peptides, small molecules, conjugates or other modalities, choosing the approach that fits the biological question.

• Guide iterative molecular design using findings from in vitro assays, in vivo pharmacology and relevant DMPK studies.

• Contribute hands-on to experimental research, such as molecular preparation, characterisation or pharmacological evaluation, according to project needs and available capabilities.

• Identify technologies that expand our ability to modulate biological targets or deliver pharmacological activity.

• Assess evidence critically and recommend which concepts to advance, redirect or discontinue.

• Mentor colleagues and communicate molecular strategies, findings and recommendations across disciplines.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape the molecular innovation agenda of a new team and contribute to its first generation of discovery projects. The role combines scientific ownership with close involvement in experimental work, using emerging biological findings to guide the development of molecular approaches.
